dt = T / n_steps
increments = rng.normal(0.0, np.sqrt(dt),
    size=(n_paths, n_steps))
W = np.zeros((n_paths, n_steps + 1))
W[:, 1:] = np.cumsum(increments, axis=1)
W[:, 500].var()   # ≈ t_grid[500]
caption: Var(W_t) tracks t exactly, the continuous-time echo of random-walk scaling.
